buildmsg.comparison: Only DOS6 differences: remove invalid leading semicolons from C copyright comment; emit two-field DOS7 class header and utility id 3 instead of 255.
buildmsg.basis: inc/msgserv.asm omits $M_COMMAND_VER under DOS7_TRANSIENT_MSG; accepted COMMAND.CLF has $M_CLASS_ID <003H,Class_F_MessageCount>. Original functions, K&R parameter declarations, formatting and message logic retained.

wrappers.decision: Retain a minimal separately assembled message-resource entry using the existing shared language INCLUDE and resmsg.equ. Initialization/resident resource classes require their own zero-based DATARES contribution/map; combining them into one object would concatenate resources or introduce artificial conditional variants. No message body is duplicated.
wrappers.changes: Indent INCLUDE/PUBLIC/END and segment declarations; normalize DOS CRLF.

validation.reason: C source unchanged; both assembly directive streams unchanged. COMMAND.COM retains T11 exact-byte acceptance.
